name: TikTok
description: Official TikTok Content Posting and Display APIs: upload videos as drafts or direct posts, and read profile and video performance. No browser automation.

permissions.label: Upload videos as drafts or direct posts (with approval)
Read video views, likes, comments, and shares

setup.docsHint: TikTok for Developers -> Manage apps -> Create app (Desktop). Add Login Kit + Content Posting API (enable Direct Post) with scopes user.info.basic, user.info.profile, user.info.stats, video.list, video.upload, video.publish. Login Kit redirect URI: http://localhost:19431/auth/callback/tiktok. Until TikTok audits the app, direct posts are private (SELF_ONLY); draft uploads work right away.
